g.text: Same checkpoint and 4,800 validation episodes | Implemented Artix-7 XC7A100T design
Lower precision saves storage and BRAM; this implementation has no per-decision speedup.
Quality is software validation. Resource counts are routed hardware; latency excludes animation pauses.
